method: Read original fixture bodies, complete sources/mutations and rubric, then final receipts/proposals/live partials and source ledger. No implementation read, model-provider call, or earlier evaluator scores used. Parent clarified course-file deletion and withdrawn-count grading; final interpretations distinguish workflow diagnostics from student requirements.
coverage: 13 observations: five targeted; three same-case full-live controls; one generated-plan full-live; two source heldouts plus two signed frozen-backend observations of those same two unique heldout cases. No additional unique heldouts. Standalone review and long mandatory-budget cases not rerun here.
interpretation: Seven targeted/heldout proposals repair their central issues; source-history replacement retains a prose attribution ambiguity. Both heldouts preserve valid facts and exact student requirements. Completed full-live restart and planning runs retain material semantic limitations. Failed controls preserve useful partials but are not successful writing delivery. No blanket beta acceptance.
